item.title: Wraith: Unwrapping the Bytecode VM Inside a 2 KB wasm Module
item.description: A 2 KB WebAssembly file with one exported function and two imports. No strings, no symbols, nothing readable. Inside it hides a tiny bytecode VM that checks the flag one byte at a time, and every check inverts in closed form.
